Eliminate transaction creation latency for wallets with extensive histories or high activity
reviewability: Clean merge status, passing CI, and recently updated with review feedback
agreement: Strong support for massive performance gains, with benchmarks showing 250x to 500x speedups (remyers, w0xlt)
Concept approval without detailed reviews (murchandamus, jonatack, rkrux)
